ROOT.scriptdef: if exists(select type from sysobjects where name='ProdPNZStan' and type='FN') drop function CDN.ProdPNZStan

CREATE FUNCTION CDN.ProdPNZStan (@PNZId int) RETURNS TINYINT as begin declare @IloscZlc INT DECLARE @DataZamkn INT
SELECT @DataZamkn = PNZ_DataZamkniecia FROM CDN.ProdNadzlecenia WHERE PNZ_Id = @PNZId IF @DataZamkn > 0 RETURN 3
SELECT @IloscZlc = COUNT(*) FROM CDN.ProdNadzleceniaLinki WHERE PNL_PNZId = @PNZId
IF @IloscZlc = 0 RETURN 0
IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM CDN.ProdNadzleceniaLinki JOIN CDN.ProdZlecenia ON PZL_Id = PNL_PZLId AND PZL_DataZamkniecia = 0 WHERE PNL_PNZId = @PNZId) RETURN 2
IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM CDN.ProdNadzleceniaLinki JOIN CDN.ProdCzynnosci ON PCZ_PZLId = PNL_PZLId WHERE PCZ_Realizuje > 0 AND PNL_PNZId = @PNZId) RETURN 1
RETURN 0
END
GRANT EXEC ON CDN.ProdPNZStan TO CDNRaport
